title: Automate Seedance 2.5 ad generation end-to-end from your code editor by wiring…
content:
Automate Seedance 2.5 ad generation end-to-end from your code editor by wiring it into a Whop connector so generated video ads can be launched directly to Whop Ads without using dashboards or editors  
Run managed agents to monitor Whop Ads performance and automatically pause Seedance-generated creatives that aren’t converting
